inspection_summary: Inspected all 4,942 split lines of the normalized 71-page article. The source develops a coupled microscopic limit of CUE characteristic-polynomial ratios as a canonical random entire function with sine-kernel zeros, derives rigidity, logarithmic-derivative, ratio-moment, linear-statistic, and mesoscopic blue-noise consequences, and formulates explicitly conditional transfers to the Riemann zeta function. The prose is recoverable throughout; exact formulas are text-layer dependent and retain moderate PDF-extraction risk, but no accepted mechanism rests on an unreadable formula alone.

sections_inspected.label: Front matter, abstract, and contents
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Bibliographic framing and compact statement of the paper's microscopic-limit, ratio, and zeta-modeling program.

sections_inspected.label: 1 Introduction
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Motivates the functional microscopic limit, explains why almost-sure coupling replaces moment methods, and separates ratio, linear-statistic, and zeta-value applications.

sections_inspected.label: 1.1 The characteristic polynomial of random unitary matrices and the number theory connections
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Defines sine-kernel scaling, the normalized characteristic-polynomial process, and its functional limiting problem.

sections_inspected.label: 1.2 Virtual isometries and almost sure convergence
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Constructs the cross-dimensional Haar coupling, states eigenangle rigidity input and the canonical infinite-product limit, and records functional consequences.

sections_inspected.label: 1.3 Outline of the paper
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: States uniform ratio-integrability and determinantal expectation results, the corresponding zeta-ratio conjecture, and the mesoscopic endpoint.

sections_inspected.label: 2.1 On the argument of the characteristic polynomial
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Converts argument variation into eigenvalue counts and proves a uniform logarithmic bound by concentration and discretization.

sections_inspected.label: 2.2 Precise estimates for the eigenvalues of virtual isometries
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Derives determinantal count variance and tail bounds and upgrades them to finite- and infinite-level eigenangle rigidity.

sections_inspected.label: 2.3 Infinite product representation of the ratio and its convergence
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Rewrites finite characteristic-polynomial ratios as symmetric zero products and proves compact convergence by paired-tail control.

sections_inspected.label: 3.1 The order of ξ∞ as an entire function
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Bounds the canonical limit above and below to identify its entire-function order.

sections_inspected.label: 3.2 Convergence of linear statistics
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Extends microscopic linear-statistic convergence to integrable tests and represents centered statistics through the boundary argument of the limiting function.

sections_inspected.label: 4 Fine estimates for the logarithmic derivative and related zeta conjectures
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Relates paired zero sums to logarithmic derivatives, proves uniform tail integrability, computes low moments, and states solver-conditional zeta analogues.

sections_inspected.label: 5.1 Expectation of ratios
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Proves ratio integrability and expectation convergence, transports a Giambelli determinant identity to CUE, and passes it to the limiting function and zeta conjecture.

sections_inspected.label: 5.2 Moments of the logarithmic derivative
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Differentiates the ratio determinant and organizes the resulting combinatorics into a general logarithmic-derivative moment formula.

sections_inspected.label: 6 Mesoscopic fluctuations and blue noise
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Reframes the logarithmic derivative as a renormalized resolvent linear statistic and defines the blue-noise target.

sections_inspected.label: 6.1 The sine kernel from afar
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Uses cumulant estimates and Sobolev completion to prove mesoscopic sine-process fluctuations converge to blue noise.

sections_inspected.label: 6.2 Application to the Stieltjes transform of the sine kernel
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Identifies the Stieltjes statistic with the centered logarithmic derivative and upgrades its Gaussian limit to a holomorphic-process limit.

accepted_units.title: Why the microscopic object must be a normalized analytic function
accepted_units.why_material: Explains that local convergence of zeros is insufficient to produce a global analytic object, while normalization by the value at 1 and a 1/n argument scaling make functional convergence plausible; it also motivates cross-dimensional coupling because ordinary moments fail.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the problem statement, normalization rationale, and the almost-sure-versus-moment-method contrast.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-grounded with light dependence on the characteristic-polynomial process notation.

accepted_units.title: Three semantic payoff channels and the prime-versus-zero scale split
accepted_units.why_material: Separates microscopic ratio/correlation questions, linear statistics, and zeta-value conjectures, and articulates the key heuristic that microscopic rescaling suppresses prime-driven long-range structure while retaining zero-driven sine-kernel structure.
accepted_units.context_note: The three-part contribution list is needed to preserve the paper's distinction between proved CUE results and conjectural zeta transfer.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Predominantly prose; exact scale references depend on displayed 1/n notation.

accepted_units.title: Matching unit mean spacings for CUE eigenangles and zeta zeros
accepted_units.why_material: Places CUE eigenangles and zeta zeros into unit-spacing coordinates and states the sine-kernel point-process comparison that underwrites the later random-matrix/zeta bridge.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes both the determinantal sine-kernel definition and the zeta zero-counting rescaling; the zeta comparison remains conjectural.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent for kernels, correlation functions, and normalization; surrounding prose makes the structural comparison recoverable.

accepted_units.title: Normalized microscopic characteristic-polynomial process and functional limit
accepted_units.why_material: Defines ξ_n as a ratio that cancels the nonconvergent common magnitude, records its functional equation, and states convergence as an entire function rather than merely convergence of zero processes.
accepted_units.context_note: The span includes the warning that local zero convergence does not determine the nonlocal infinite product and introduces mutual ratios as observables.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderately formula-dependent; the ratio, functional equation, and compact-uniform topology are readable in the text layer.

accepted_units.title: Virtual-isometry coupling across matrix dimensions
accepted_units.why_material: Constructs Haar unitary matrices on one probability space via rank-one extensions and turns marginal convergence into pointwise eigenangle convergence with a quantitative central-window error.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the recursive coupling, periodic eigenangle indexing, and the imported almost-sure convergence estimate required later.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Depends on matrix recursion and indexed eigenangle formulas; prose supplies the coupling semantics.

accepted_units.title: Canonical paired infinite product with sine-kernel zeros
accepted_units.why_material: States the almost-sure compact-uniform convergence to an entire function whose symmetrically paired product is absolutely convergent and whose zeros are exactly the limiting sine process.
accepted_units.context_note: Kept as a compact theorem unit including the explanation of entire-ness and zero identification.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-central; paired-factor grouping is essential and should be checked against the retained PDF for exact notation.

accepted_units.title: Functional convergence transfers directly to ratios and derivatives
accepted_units.why_material: Shows how convergence in the holomorphic-function topology simultaneously yields almost-sure limits for arbitrary finite ratios and derivatives, while flagging expectation convergence as a separate integrability problem.
accepted_units.context_note: Denominators must avoid the random real zero set; expectation convergence is deferred to Section 5.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent but structurally explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: Logarithms and eigenvalue counts from a pathwise analytic limit
accepted_units.why_material: Uses a zero-avoiding contour to pass convergence from entire functions to chosen logarithm branches, then turns the imaginary logarithm into microscopic eigenvalue counts.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes both the branch-control mechanism and the count identity, which would be unsafe if detached.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Depends on contour-integral and argument formulas; prose clearly states the nonvanishing requirement.

accepted_units.title: Logarithmic derivative as a symmetrically summed resolvent
accepted_units.why_material: Identifies the microscopic characteristic-polynomial logarithmic derivative with a meromorphic sum over limiting sine-kernel zeros, giving the basic resolvent representation used throughout the paper.
accepted_units.context_note: The sum is symmetrically paired rather than absolutely summed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-central, with recoverable summation convention.

accepted_units.title: Uniform ratio moments, determinant identity, and zeta-ratio transfer
accepted_units.why_material: Packages the uniform integrability needed to pass ratio expectations to the limit, states the limiting determinant identity, and isolates its conditional zeta analogue.
accepted_units.context_note: This source-level theorem distinguishes proved CUE/ξ∞ statements from the explicit zeta conjecture at lines 709-726.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Highly formula-dependent for the determinant and half-plane factors; prose explains why the resulting conjecture is simpler.

accepted_units.title: Argument variation converts spectral counting into eigenangle error
accepted_units.why_material: Relates the number of zeros on an arc to the change in the characteristic-polynomial argument, yielding an exact bridge between argument control and deviation of renormalized eigenangles from their indices.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes Proposition 2.1, its sawtooth interpretation, and the corollary specialized to indexed eigenangles.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The counting identity is formula-dependent; the piecewise-linear/jump interpretation is prose-grounded.

accepted_units.title: From one-point subgaussian control to a uniform circle bound
accepted_units.why_material: Derives a Chernoff bound from the Gamma-product moment generating function, applies rotational invariance and Borel-Cantelli on a regular grid, and fills grid gaps using the deterministic sawtooth behavior of the argument.
accepted_units.context_note: The reusable move is concentration plus discretization plus deterministic interpolation, not the routine intermediate algebra.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-heavy, but the three-stage proof strategy is clear in prose.

accepted_units.title: Determinantal count variance, Bernstein tails, and exponential moments
accepted_units.why_material: Obtains uniform finite/infinite sine-process counting estimates from Fourier variance formulas and the Bernoulli decomposition of determinantal counts, furnishing the tail control needed for rigidity and analytic tails.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the variance logarithm, Bernstein-type tail, and exponential-moment bound as one reusable certification package.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Substantially formula-dependent; accepted because checked prose identifies the determinantal and Bernoulli mechanisms.

accepted_units.title: Global logarithmic rigidity by patching count tails and coupling
accepted_units.why_material: Turns interval-count concentration into y_k=k+O(log|k|) for the infinite sine process and combines global finite-n argument bounds with central-window coupling to obtain the uniform finite-level estimate.
accepted_units.context_note: The split into large-index and central-index regimes is essential to the patching argument.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate formula dependence; the regime split and Borel-Cantelli logic are prose-recoverable.

accepted_units.title: Finite ratio rewritten as a symmetric product over periodic eigenangles
accepted_units.why_material: Uses the sine product and periodic eigenangle indexing to transform the normalized characteristic polynomial from a finite matrix product into the same symmetric zero-product representation used at the limit.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the boundary-factor comparison that justifies replacing periodic rectangular truncations by symmetric index truncations.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-central and extraction-sensitive; the prose verifies the periodicity and asymptotically negligible quotient.

accepted_units.title: Paired tail control plus pointwise convergence yields compact functional convergence
accepted_units.why_material: Uses logarithmic rigidity to pair positive and negative factors, obtains uniform O(log A/A) product-tail errors, and combines finite-factor convergence with Montel's theorem.
accepted_units.context_note: This is the analytic closure of the coupling argument and includes both finite-n and limiting tails.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-heavy; the paired cancellation and uniformity in n are the indispensable structural facts.

accepted_units.title: Order-one growth of the canonical entire function
accepted_units.why_material: Partitions product factors into three regimes to prove an exp(O(|z|log|z|)) upper bound and uses the imaginary axis product to obtain exponential lower growth, identifying order one.
accepted_units.context_note: The three-regime decomposition is retained because it explains how rigidity converts into entire-function growth.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent but the regime logic is robustly recoverable.

accepted_units.title: Microscopic linear-statistic convergence for all integrable tests
accepted_units.why_material: Extends compactly supported bounded-test convergence by truncating the test function and controlling the discarded part solely through the unit one-point intensity.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the analogous zeta-zero statement only as Conjecture 3.3 and explains its stronger logarithmic integrability condition.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Light formula dependence; the truncation and characteristic-function argument are prose-grounded.

accepted_units.title: Centered linear statistics as an integral of the boundary argument
accepted_units.why_material: Uses summation by parts against the counting function to express a centered linear statistic as the integral of Im log ξ against f', linking point configurations to analytic boundary data.
accepted_units.context_note: The decay and differentiability hypotheses are included because they kill boundary terms.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent for the final identity; derivation is readable.

accepted_units.title: Zeta functional-limit conjecture supported by paired Hadamard zero sums
accepted_units.why_material: States process-level convergence of a locally normalized zeta function and its logarithmic derivative, then shows the zeta logarithmic derivative decomposes into the same paired zero-resolvent plus the same iπ archimedean term as ξ∞.
accepted_units.context_note: The CUE identity is proved; the zeta process convergence remains conjectural and is motivated by GUE behavior of the renormalized zeros.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-central, especially the scaling and Hadamard decomposition; prose explicitly marks evidentiary status.

accepted_units.title: Index-symmetric and spatial-window truncations agree
accepted_units.why_material: Shows that the paired logarithmic-derivative sum can equivalently be truncated by spectral location |y_k|<A, with rigidity making the boundary discrepancy only O(log A) terms of size O(1/A).
accepted_units.context_note: This permits later use of point-process correlation functions on bounded windows.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate formula dependence; the boundary-layer counting argument is prose-recoverable.

accepted_units.title: Uniform exponential control of logarithmic-derivative tails
accepted_units.why_material: Partitions the far spectrum into growing blocks, separates deterministic mean cancellation from centered count fluctuations, and combines Jensen with determinantal exponential moments to control tails uniformly over finite and infinite n.
accepted_units.context_note: The long span is retained as a coherent technical mechanism; its conclusion requires the block construction, probability weights, and final α=2 optimization.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Very formula-heavy with moderate extraction risk; accepted because checked prose and displayed inequalities preserve the block/Jensen/concentration architecture.

accepted_units.title: Lp tail decay licenses moment passage through infinite zero sums
accepted_units.why_material: Converts exponential tail control into quantitative Lp decay, proves the logarithmic derivative has moments of every order off the real axis, and justifies computing moments by bounded-window correlation functions followed by A→∞.
accepted_units.context_note: This is the integrability gate separating formal infinite-sum manipulations from legitimate moment calculations.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent for rates and norms; logical role is explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: Low logarithmic-derivative moments from sine-kernel correlations
accepted_units.why_material: Computes the first and second moments by splitting diagonal and off-diagonal point contributions, evaluating kernel integrals, and extending by L2 continuity.
accepted_units.context_note: The detailed contour algebra supports the final covariance formulas; the reusable mechanism is correlation expansion plus justified window removal.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Highly formula-dependent and should be PDF-checked before exact reuse; prose securely identifies each decomposition.

accepted_units.title: Zeta logarithmic-derivative moments as a pair-correlation criterion
accepted_units.why_material: Transfers the computed ξ∞ covariance to a two-point zeta logarithmic-derivative conjecture and records that its diagonal specialization is equivalent, under RH, to the pair-correlation conjecture.
accepted_units.context_note: Explicitly conjectural and conditional; higher moments are suggested as higher-correlation probes.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-central for signs and scalings, with explanatory prose at lines 2881-2889.

accepted_units.title: Balanced off-real ratios are uniformly integrable and converge in expectation
accepted_units.why_material: Uses zero-free paths and exponential logarithmic-derivative bounds to prove uniform ratio moments, then combines almost-sure compact convergence with uniform integrability to pass arbitrary balanced ratio expectations to ξ∞.
accepted_units.context_note: The off-real compactness and equal numerator/denominator factor counts are essential hypotheses.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent for bounds; the path-integral and uniform-integrability mechanism is clear.

accepted_units.title: Giambelli determinant identity transported from polynomial ensembles to CUE
accepted_units.why_material: Specializes a formal determinant identity for Vandermonde polynomial ensembles to CUE characteristic polynomials and carefully upgrades formal-series validity to analytic domains by absolute convergence, holomorphic continuation, arc removal, and dominated convergence.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the one-ratio expectation determined by inside/outside-circle symmetry, which supplies the determinant entries.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Strongly formula-dependent; the analytic-continuation mechanism and domain conditions are prose-recoverable.

accepted_units.title: Limiting determinant formula for ratios and its zeta conjecture
accepted_units.why_material: Combines the finite-n determinant with expectation convergence to obtain an explicit ξ∞ ratio-moment formula, handles coincident points by cancellation or continuity, and states the matching randomized-zeta limit.
accepted_units.context_note: The limiting ξ∞ identity is proved; the zeta formula is conjectural, with a cited conditional implication from RH plus GUE.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-central for determinant and half-plane factors; evidentiary distinction is explicit.

accepted_units.title: General logarithmic-derivative moments by differentiating ratio determinants
accepted_units.why_material: Uses uniform ratio bounds to differentiate expectations, expands the Cauchy determinant, and reduces a large derivative expansion through fixed points, involutions, and cycle cancellation to a closed permutation formula for arbitrary joint moments.
accepted_units.context_note: The span is long because the final formula depends on the combinatorial cancellation proof, not merely its statement.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extremely formula-heavy with text-layer risk; accepted at the mechanism level, while exact combinatorial notation requires PDF verification.

accepted_units.title: Centered logarithmic derivative as a resolvent linear statistic and blue-noise target
accepted_units.why_material: Interprets ξ∞'/ξ∞−iπ as a conditionally convergent resolvent trace of the operator with sine-process spectrum and defines blue noise through its H^{1/2} spectral covariance.
accepted_units.context_note: The operator interpretation is explicitly informal because the resolvent series is not absolutely convergent.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent for Sobolev norm and covariance; conceptual reframing is prose-grounded.

accepted_units.title: Mesoscopic sine-process fluctuations converge to blue noise
accepted_units.why_material: Adapts cumulant bounds from finite CUE, passes them to the sine process, extends the statistic continuously to H^{1/2}, and proves that dilation kills higher cumulants while preserving the |k|-weighted variance.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes approximation from smooth compactly supported tests to all H^{1/2} tests and the finite-dimensional reduction.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-heavy, especially Fourier normalization and cumulants; prose clearly records the limiting mechanism.

accepted_units.title: Stieltjes statistic equals the centered logarithmic derivative
accepted_units.why_material: Approximates 1/(z−t) by compactly supported H^{1/2} tests and identifies the resulting centered sine-process statistic with ξ∞'/ξ∞ minus its half-plane deterministic term.
accepted_units.context_note: The cutoff argument and L2 limit are included to avoid treating a nonintegrable-looking Stieltjes sum formally.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-central but supported by explicit cutoff and norm estimates.

accepted_units.title: Gaussian scaling limit and covariance of the logarithmic-derivative field
accepted_units.why_material: Applies blue-noise convergence to Stieltjes tests, obtaining a centered Gaussian field under large-scale dilation and computing its same-/opposite-half-plane covariance explicitly.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes consistency between the limiting covariance and the earlier exact finite-scale second moments.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent for covariance; Fourier-transform derivation is recoverable.

accepted_units.title: From finite-dimensional Gaussian limits to a holomorphic process
accepted_units.why_material: Uses increment bounds for continuity, contour covariance plus Morera-type reasoning for holomorphicity, and uniform Kolmogorov estimates for tightness, upgrading finite-dimensional convergence to compact-uniform convergence on C\R.
accepted_units.context_note: The proof treats opposite and same half-planes separately and preserves the exclusion of the real axis.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderately formula-dependent; the continuity-holomorphicity-tightness sequence is explicit in prose.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Coupling produces a canonical analytic object rather than only a local zero limit
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The virtual-isometry coupling supplies pointwise spectral control, the finite product is recoded in the limiting zero representation, and paired rigidity tails upgrade those ingredients to an almost-sure compact-uniform entire-function limit.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: This mechanism is established for the coupled CUE construction; it does not by itself construct an analogous coupling for zeta.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Zero configurations become analytic, counting, and linear-statistic observables
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The same canonical product turns zeros into logarithmic derivatives, arguments, counts, centered linear statistics, and a cutoff-justified Stieltjes transform, providing several interchangeable views of the sine process.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Equivalence requires the stated branch, decay, off-real, and symmetric-truncation conditions.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Rigidity is the common control layer for global analytic tails
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Argument concentration and determinantal count tails yield logarithmic rigidity, which in turn controls paired products and, after blockwise fluctuation estimates, licenses Lp manipulation of infinite logarithmic-derivative sums.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The strongest uniform tail bounds use determinantal-specific count estimates and should not be presumed for an arbitrary zero process.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Ratio integrability unlocks determinant identities and arbitrary derivative moments
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Uniform off-real exponential control supplies the analytic integrability gate; this permits finite-n Giambelli identities to pass to ξ∞ and permits differentiation of ratio moments into general logarithmic-derivative moment formulas.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Exact formulas depend on balanced ratios, off-real compact sets, and extraction-sensitive determinant/combinatorial notation.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: The zeta bridge isolates a zero-driven microscopic process hypothesis
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Unit-spacing normalization and paired Hadamard sums motivate a single process-level hypothesis whose ratio and logarithmic-derivative consequences agree with GUE/pair-correlation predictions while conceptually suppressing prime-driven longer-range structure.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: All transfers from ξ∞ to zeta are conjectural or conditional; CUE agreement is not independent evidence for RH or for a zeta functional limit.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Mesoscopic dilation turns the sine resolvent into a holomorphic blue-noise field
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The resolvent belongs to the H^{1/2} statistic space, dilation preserves the blue-noise variance while suppressing higher cumulants, and covariance plus tightness upgrades the resulting Gaussian limit to compact-uniform holomorphic convergence off the real axis.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The theorem concerns the sine-kernel process and the centered field away from the real line; it does not establish boundary convergence or the conjectural zeta analogue.
